objective: Reduce recognition errors on previously unseen speakers without reference leakage

official_decoding.language: same specified language as current product
official_decoding.audio_processing: unchanged frozen 16k PCM, full answer, no noise suppression or speed changes
official_decoding.primary_text: Decode generated token suffix only with tokenizer skip_special_tokens=True and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False; forced-language prefill belongs to input and is excluded with all input tokens; no repetition repair
official_decoding.official_processed_text: Retain processor parsed/transcription_only output separately as diagnostic because Transformers 5.19.0 applies built-in repetition repair; never substitute it for primary text based on reference scores
official_decoding.interface_audit_note: Recorded before first official model inference after reading installed Transformers 5.19.0 source; ndarray audio is passed unchanged with explicit 16000 Hz processor audio_kwargs

data_policy.holdout: 8 new speakers frozen independently before inference, 4 Chinese 4 English
data_policy.references: scorer only, model process accepts whitelist with no reference

acceptance.recognition: Per-language corpus errors and per-speaker scores, keep all failures, no reference-based selection
acceptance.deployment: Native improvement alone does not validate browser. Resource use and WebAssembly/browser availability checked separately
acceptance.punctuation: MELI N/A; keep real punctuation without altering lexical scoring
